info.title: Spots Backend API
info.description: REST API for the Spots social photo-sharing application, including authentication, privacy-aware posts, follows, comments, bookmarks, collections, notifications, profiles, and nearby discovery.

409.description: An account with that email already exists

post.summary: Rotate the refresh session and issue an access token

get.summary: Get a privacy-aware user post gallery

delete.summary: Delete an owned post and dependent records

get.summary: List comments for a visible post

post.summary: Follow a public user or request access to a private user

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's notification inbox

delete.summary: Clear the authenticated user's notification inbox
